svg.title: One lit pane, spread over three
svg.desc: A light box with three panes in a row and a cover on rails. Slid back, the cover shows that only the first pane, marked Checked, is lit teal; the other two, marked Assumed, sit dark in a shared well that lights magenta. Laid over the panes, the cover glowed evenly teal, as if all three were lit.
